   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Thursday, November 21, 2019

  CALL TO ORDER
  ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo, Liao,
  Harrington

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Pursuant to provisions of the Government Code §54957, this is the time provided
  for members of the public to address the City Council regarding matters on this
  Agenda.

2.  URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN GABRIEL,
  CALIFORNIA,  ESTABLISHING  INTERIM  PROHIBITION  OF
  NO-FAULT EVICTIONS THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2019, FOR RESIDENTIAL
  REAL PROPERTY BUILT PRIOR TO JANUARY 1, 2005 PURSUANT TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 36934 AND 36937

  California recently passed the Tenant Protection Act of 2019, Assembly Bill 1482
  (“AB 1482”), effective January 1, 2020, which prohibits evictions without “just cause”
  and prevents owners of residential rental property from increasing rents more than
  five percent within a twelve-month period, plus the percentage change in the cost
  of living or ten percent, whichever is lower. In advance of the implementation of
  AB 1482, no-fault evictions and threats of eviction have surged. The City Council
  will consider the adoption of Urgency Ordinance No. 659 establishing interim
  prohibition of no-fault evictions through December 31, 2019, for residential real
  property built prior to January 1, 2005 pursuant to Government Code Sections
  36934 and 36937.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt as an Urgency Ordinance, Ordinance
  No. 659 establishing interim prohibition of no-fault evictions through December
  31, 2019, for residential real property built prior to January 1, 2005 pursuant to
  Government Code Sections 36934 and 36937.

3.  ADJOURN COUNCIL MEETING

  The next Special City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, December 3, 2019
  at 7:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California. Information regarding matters to be considered at each
  meeting will be available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the
  City’s website at www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 21, 2019
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Pu called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 7:00 a.m.
  on Tuesday, November 21 , 2019, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission
  Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776, and announced that Council Member Liao was
  attending by telephone conference from San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter, Room 529,
  100 Bowie Street, San Antonio, Texas 78205.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Juli Costanzo, John R. Harrington, Chin Ho Liao (by
  telephonic conference), Vice Mayor Denise Menchaca,
  and Mayor Jason Pu.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto; Deputy City Attorney
  Martin de los Angeles; Assistant City Manager/
  Community Development Director Armine Chaparyan;

I  Chief City Clerk Sharon F. Clark; and Assistant City Clerk
  Marilyn Bonus.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  The following speakers their consideration of this item and requested that a
  moratoriumon no-fault evictions be enacted prior to new legislation enacting the
  same that goes into effect January 1, 2020: Eric Sunada; Sean McMorris, resident; and
  Teresa Eilers, United Way Everyone In.

  2. URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN GABRIEL,
  CALIFORNIA. ESTABLISHING INTERIM PROHIBITION OF NO-FAULT EVICTIONS
  THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2019, FOR RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY BUILT PRIOR
  TO JANUARY 1. 2005 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 36934 and
  36937

  Presentation was made by Deputy City Attorney Martin de los Angeles.

I  Discussion included how displacement has negative effects on the community, similar
  ordinances adopted by other cities; and clarification that the ordinance would be
  effective immediately upon adoption.

  A motion was made by Council Member Liao, seconded by Council Member
  Harrington, to adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 659 establishing interim prohibition of
  no-fault evictions through December 31 , 2019, for residential real property built prior
  to January 1, 2005 pursuant to Government Code Sections 36934 and 36937.

  Motion carried by a roll-call vote of 5-0 as follows:
